name: Klariqo
summary: Polished voice-agent platform for SMB outbound. Strong UX but enterprise-only pricing and a login wall block full verification.

claims.evidence: "Klariqo: AI Voice Agents for Call Centers & BPOs"

claims.claim: Primary value proposition is articulated in first viewport
claims.evidence: Only send qualified transfers to your closers. We handle everything else.

claims.evidence: "link" name="Pricing" and "link" name="Get Started" are present on the homepage.
